title: aalam e hasti pe faize abre gouhar baar hai
body:
aalame hasti pe faize abre gouhar baar hai
aamade kazim se har soo baarishe anwaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jiske jalwo ki zia baari se roushan hai jahan
jo sifaate haq ka maz'har hai nabi aasaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
munkire haq ho nahi sakta kabhi aisa bashar
saatwe haadi ka dil se jis ko bhi iqraar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
har nafs wirde zabaan ho musie kazim ka naam
ye na ho to zindagi phir aapki bekaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
fitrate masoom hai hargiz badal sakti nahi
dekhie chouda ke chouda ka wahi kirdaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
qouf kya keejiye bhala haalaat ke toofan ka
ho vilaae aale payambar to beda paar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ghair ki janib badhaata hi nahi daste talab
ye dare kaazim ka saail kis qadar quddaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
baat kya hai is pe bhi kuch ghour karna chaahiye
doure haazir ka musalma'n kyu zaleelo qaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
har yazeede waqt ka jisse dehel jaata hai dil
ek aseere zulm ki zanjeer ki jhankaar hai
